# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest commit on `main` is currently supported. LedgerX has no versioned releases or supported release branches.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests. Use **Report a vulnerability** in the repository's **Security** tab to send a private report when GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting is enabled.

If private reporting is unavailable, do not post vulnerability details publicly. Contact the repository owner through a contact method already listed on the public GitHub profile, if one is available.

Include a concise description, affected component and commit or version, impact, steps to reproduce, and any relevant sanitized logs or proof of concept. Do not include real credentials, personal data, or access to live systems.

The maintainer will make reasonable efforts to acknowledge and investigate reports promptly and coordinate disclosure after a fix is available. Response and remediation times depend on severity and maintainer availability; no fixed service level is promised.

Please give the maintainer a reasonable opportunity to investigate and address the issue before public disclosure. Avoid accessing or altering other users' data, disrupting services, or exploiting a vulnerability beyond what is needed to demonstrate it.
